# Superior Bag

> Superior Bag manufactures tamper-evident security bags and specialized deposit solutions for financial institutions, law enforcement, casinos, and pharmaceutical companies.

Superior Bag is a leading provider of tamper-proof deposit bags, evidence bags, and cash-in-transit solutions with Federal Reserve and FDIC compliance. The company offers both standard products and customized services like Turnkey™ and Customer Connection for enterprise clients.

## Key Topics

- Tamper-evident security bags
- Chain of custody
- Cash-in-transit
- Evidence bags
- Deposit bags
- FDIC compliance
- Federal Reserve
- Law enforcement
- VOID tape closure
- D-TEC Dual Seal™
- Cash handling
- Banking supplies
- Turnkey™ service
- Tamper-proof construction
- Security compliance

## Core Products

- [Tamper Evident Security Bags for Currency Storage](https://superiorbag.com/products): Main products page featuring Superior Bag's tamper-evident security bags and Federal Reserve-compliant solutions.
- [Retail Bags, Deposit Bags, Cash Transfer Bags](https://superiorbag.com/product-category/retail): Retail deposit bags and cash transfer security solutions for retail businesses.
- [Cash In Transit Bags - Tamper-Evident Bank Bags](https://superiorbag.com/product-category/cash-in-transit): FDIC-compliant cash-in-transit and bank bags with tamper-evident construction.
- [Law Enforcement Evidence Bags](https://superiorbag.com/product-category/law-enforcement): Law enforcement evidence bags with chain-of-custody compliance for evidence preservation.
- [Casino Bags - Money Tracking Bags](https://superiorbag.com/product-category/casino): Casino money tracking bags with chain-of-custody and tamper-evident security.
- [Pharmaceutical Transport Bags](https://superiorbag.com/product-category/pharmaceutical): Pharmaceutical transport bags with chain-of-custody for secure medical shipments.
- [Shipping & Postal Bags](https://superiorbag.com/product-category/shipping-postal): Waterproof shipping and postal bags with tamper-evident features for secure mailing.
- [Security Bag Accessories](https://superiorbag.com/product-category/accessories): Security bag accessories including bill straps, coin wrappers, and banking supplies.

## Enterprise Services

- [Customer Connection Service](https://superiorbag.com/services/customer-connection): Customer Connection service for designing customized product selections for financial institutions.
